routes.label: Total distance divided by total time

question: Kate rode her bicycle for \(30\) minutes at a speed of \(16\) mph, then walked for \(90\) minutes at a speed of \(4\) mph. What was her overall average speed in miles per hour?
solution:
Overall average speed is total distance divided by total time, so first find the distance for each part of the trip. The times are \(30\) minutes \(=\tfrac12\) hour and \(90\) minutes \(=\tfrac32\) hours. Thus Kate rides \(16\cdot\tfrac12=8\) miles and walks \(4\cdot\tfrac32=6\) miles. Her average speed is
\[
\frac{8+6}{\tfrac12+\tfrac32}
=\frac{14}{2}=7\text{ mph}.
\]
The answer is choice A.
